name: HD Knife
author: Sixth Front
description: The knife is held in a real gloved hand instead of floating: fingers wrapped round the grip, thumb over the top, hard-knuckle glove, sleeve up the forearm. The knife itself is a detailed 7 inch combat knife with a polished edge, fuller, steel guard, stacked leather handle and pommel. Melee alternates forehand and backhand slashes with a motion trail and a hit-stop when it connects; takedowns from behind are a stab.
script: // Replaces the floating melee blade with a gloved right hand gripping a full combat knife:
// clip-point blade with fuller, ground edge and swedge, steel guard, stacked leather handle and
// pommel. Three animations: forehand slash, backhand slash, and a stab for takedowns from behind.
// Older game versions: a hidden model's remove() runs when the mod is switched off
const h = api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01] }], { x: 0, y: -500, z: 0 });
const V = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const smooth = (a, b, x) => { const t = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a)); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
const trash = []; // geometries, materials and textures to free when the mod is switched off
const canvasTex = (w, h, paint, rx = 1, ry = 1) => {
const x = c.getContext('2d'), img = x.createImageData(w, h);
for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, paint(i, j) | 0)), k = (j * w + i) * 4;
const weave = canvasTex(64, 64, (i, j) => 128 + 46 * Math.sin(i * 1.6) * Math.sin(j * 1.6) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50, 3, 3);
// Brushed steel: fine streaks along the blade
const grain = canvasTex(64, 64, (i, j) => 128 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 90 + 20 * Math.sin(i * 0.7 + j * 0.3), 6, 2);
// A small studio for the metal to reflect: dark floor, bright sky, two softboxes
const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(10, 32, 16), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
vertexShader: 'varying vec3 p; void main(){ p = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.); }',

fragmentShader: 'varying vec3 p; void main(){ float h = p.y; vec3 c = mix(vec3(0.16,0.15,0.14), vec3(0.62,0.66,0.72), smoothstep(-0.25, 0.45, h)); c += vec3(0.3) * smoothstep(0.75, 1.0, h); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.); }',
const box = (w, h, x, y, z, k) => {
const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(k, k, k * 0.97), side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
const steelOpts = { metalness: 1, envMap: env, envMapIntensity: 1 };
satin: std({ ...steelOpts, color: 0xc4c8cd, roughness: 0.5, roughnessMap: brushed }),
fuller: std({ ...steelOpts, color: 0xa9aeb4, roughness: 0.6, roughnessMap: brushed }),
leather: std({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.78, bumpMap: grain, bumpScale: 0.6 }),
glove: std({ color: 0x38332c, roughness: 0.92, bumpMap: weave, bumpScale: 0.8 }),
suede: std({ color: 0x5a4c3b, roughness: 0.97, bumpMap: weave, bumpScale: 1.2 }),
plate: std({ color: 0x1d1e20, roughness: 0.48, metalness: 0.1, envMap: env, envMapIntensity: 0.4 }),
strap: std({ color: 0x232322, roughness: 0.85, bumpMap: weave, bumpScale: 0.6 }),
sleeve: std({ color: 0x5f5e44, roughness: 0.95, bumpMap: weave, bumpScale: 1 }),
// Built with the blade pointing up +Y from the guard, the edge toward -Z and the spine toward +Z.
// Cross-section at fraction k along the blade: right-hand side points from spine to edge
const zs = 0.0115 - 0.0135 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, (k - 0.64) / 0.36), 1.7); // spine, dropping into the clip
const ze = -0.0185 + 0.0165 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, (k - 0.55) / 0.45), 2.1); // edge, sweeping up the belly
const t = (0.0029 - 0.0014 * k * k) * (1 - Math.pow(k, 14)); // distal taper
const ts = t * (1 - 0.9 * clip);                             // the clip is sharpened (swedge)
const e = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - Math.pow((k - 0.33) / 0.29, 2))); // fuller with rounded ends
const zg = zs - 0.5 * w, zb = ze + 0.085 * w;
return [[ts, zs], [t, zsh], [t, zc + hw], [t - d, zc], [t, zc - hw], [t, zg], [Math.min(t, 0.0004), zb], [0, ze]];
for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const k = i / N; secs.push([k * (L + 0.006) - 0.006, section(Math.max(0, k))]); }
// Each facet is its own strip so the bevels stay crisp: [first point, last point, material]
cols.forEach(([x, z], j) => { pos.push(x, y, z); uv.push(i / N * 3, j / (cols.length - 1) * 0.3); });
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = 0; j < m - 1; j++) {
const a = base + i * m + j, b = a + m, c = a + 1, d = b + 1;
if (flip) idx.push(a, c, b, c, d, b); else idx.push(a, b, c, c, b, d);
add((s) => s.slice(a, b + 1), mat, true);                               // right flat
add((s) => s.slice(a, b + 1).map(([x, z]) => [-x, z]), mat, false);     // left flat
guardShape.absarc(0, z0, r, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, false);
const guardGeo = keep(new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(guardShape, { depth: 0.0035, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.0012, bevelSize: 0.001, bevelSegments: 3, curveSegments: 16 }));
// Stacked leather washers, slightly barrel shaped, oval in section
const f = i / 300, y = top + (bot - top) * f;
const ring = f * n, dist = Math.abs(ring - Math.round(ring));
pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(0.0128 + 0.0011 * Math.sin(Math.PI * f) - 0.0006 * groove, y));
// each washer its own shade of brown, darker in the joints
const shades = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3);
const ring = ((top - p.getY(i)) / (top - bot)) * n, dist = Math.abs(ring - Math.round(ring));
// Steel butt cap with the peened tang nut
const geo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(prof.map(([r, y]) => new THREE.Vector2(r, y)), 28);
const nut = new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.0042, 0.0042, 0.002, 6)), M.guard);
// Right hand in a hammer grip around the handle: palm on the +X flat, knuckles toward the edge,
// fingers wrapping round to the -X side, thumb over the index finger, wrist toward +Z.
const capsule = (a, b, r, mat, parent = hand) => {
const m = new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r, len, 6, 14)), mat);
const tube = (a, b, r0, r1, mat, parent = hand) => {
const m = new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r1, r0, len, 18, 1, true)), mat);
// Rounded box / ellipsoid: a sphere pushed out toward a box (n = 2 is an ellipsoid, higher is boxier)
const blob = (c, sx, sy, sz, mat, n = 2, q = null, parent = hand) => {
p.setXYZ(i, f(p.getX(i)) * sx, f(p.getY(i)) * sy, f(p.getZ(i)) * sz);
// Fingers: index nearest the guard. Each one runs knuckle -> round the edge side -> up the far flat -> tip into the palm
const ax = 0.0108, az = 0.0149; // handle half sizes
const ex = ax + f.r + 0.0008, ez = az + f.r + 0.0008;
const at = (deg, y) => V(ex * Math.cos(deg * Math.PI / 180), y, ez * Math.sin(deg * Math.PI / 180));
blob(j1, f.r * 1.08, f.r * 1.04, f.r * 1.08, M.glove); // knuckle bulge
blob(tip.clone().lerp(j2, 0.25), f.r * 0.98, f.r * 0.94, f.r * 0.98, M.glove); // fingertip
// Back of the hand: runs from the knuckles back to the wrist at an angle (the handle sits diagonally in the palm)
// Heel of the palm and the thumb muscle, pressing round the spine side of the handle
// Thumb wraps over the spine side and lies across the index and middle fingers
// Hard knuckle guard: a moulded plate with a bump over each knuckle
// Wrist: glove cuff with a strap, then the sleeve
const fDir = V(0.32, -Math.sin(1.08), Math.cos(1.08)).normalize(); // forearm, from the wrist toward the elbow
// The forearm is its own piece, running along its +Z from the wrist, so the wrist can bend
const m = new THREE.Mesh(keep(new THREE.TorusGeometry(r, t, 8, 24)), M.sleeve);
// inner: knife space -> rig space, where the blade points forward (-Z), edge down, back of the hand right
const pivot = V(0.008, -0.047, 0.004); // middle of the fist
rig.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh) { o.frustumCulled = false; o.castShadow = false; o.receiveShadow = false; } });
// Motion trail behind the edge while the blade is moving fast
const tPos = new Float32Array((TK + 1) * 2 * 3), tCol = new Float32Array((TK + 1) * 2 * 4), tIdx = [];
for (let k = 0; k < TK; k++) { const a = k * 2; tIdx.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2); }
const trail = new THREE.Mesh(trailGeo, keep(new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true, transparent: true, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
// Keyframes in camera space: position, and [pitch, yaw, twist] of the blade
const K = (t, p, r, e = 'io') => ({ t, p, r, e });
// forehand: cock high on the right, cut down across to the lower left
// backhand: reach across to the left, then cut back out to the right
// takedown: raise, drive the point forward and down, twist, pull out
// The hand rolls about the blade so the forearm always reaches back toward the right shoulder;
// each keyframe's third angle is an extra twist on top of that
const _e = new THREE.Euler(), _q0 = new THREE.Quaternion(), _s = V(0, 0, 0);
const p0 = (keys[i - 1] || a).p, p1 = a.p, p2 = b.p, p3 = (keys[i + 2] || b).p;
const u2 = u * u, u3 = u2 * u;
const pitch = a.r[0] + (b.r[0] - a.r[0]) * u, yaw = a.r[1] + (b.r[1] - a.r[1]) * u, twist = a.r[2] + (b.r[2] - a.r[2]) * u;
// Then the wrist bends (up to 50 degrees) to point the forearm right at the shoulder
const _qh = new THREE.Quaternion(), _w = V(0, 0, 0), _qt = new THREE.Quaternion();
const st = { anim: 'slash', next: 'slash', last: 0, hit: false, stabAt: -9, hitAt: -9 };
pc.hdKnife = { rig, trail, ANIMS, st, pose }; // handy for other mods
const _p = V(0, 0, 0), _q = new THREE.Quaternion(), _qa = new THREE.Quaternion(), _qb = new THREE.Quaternion(), _a = V(0, 0, 0), _b = V(0, 0, 0), _c = V(0, 0, 0), _pa = V(0, 0, 0), _pb = V(0, 0, 0);
const TIP = V(0, L + 0.004, -0.002).applyMatrix4(inner.matrix), MID = V(0, 0.07, -0.016).applyMatrix4(inner.matrix);
// a short hit-stop when the blade connects
const mine = function (dt, speed, bobX, bobY) {
if (m <= 0) { rig.visible = false; trail.visible = false; return; }
// the gun drops out of the way while the knife is out
const drop = smooth(0, 0.16, t) * (1 - smooth(0.78, 1, t));
gp.y -= drop * 0.42; gp.x += drop * 0.1; gr.x -= drop * 0.7; gr.z -= drop * 0.4;
this.vmRoot.visible = true; // scoped rifles hide the gun; the knife still shows
// impact shake just after the blade connects
// night battles dim the reflections with the rest of the viewmodel light
for (const [mat, k] of metals) mat.envMapIntensity = k * scale;
// trail: sweep of the edge over the last moments, brighter the faster it moved
const span = 0.16, c0 = keys[1].t, c1 = keys[2].t;
const win = smooth(c0, c0 + 0.05, t) * (1 - smooth(c1 + 0.02, c1 + 0.12, t));
const tk = Math.max(c0, t - (k / TK) * span);
const alpha = clamp01((v - 2.5) / 5) * Math.pow(1 - k / TK, 1.6) * 0.22 * scale * win;
// In a vehicle or when dead the viewmodel is not updated: hide the knife every frame first
if (!pc.meleeT || !P || P.state !== 'alive' || P.vehicle) { rig.visible = false; trail.visible = false; }
api.on('spawn', (s) => { if (s.isPlayer) { rig.visible = false; trail.visible = false; } });
if (pc._updateVM === mine) { if (prev) pc._updateVM = prev; else delete pc._updateVM; }
